results.details: Gateway and ingestor reconnected; first telemetry row stamped after the broker came back. Readings published during the outage were dropped (QoS 0).
Simulator watchdog re-registered A109 equipment after 2.1s; telemetry flowing again after 3.8s.
48.0°C request clamped to 28.0°C and 4.0°C request clamped to 16.0°C by the deterministic guardrail. The MPC overwrites the test setpoint on its next cycle.
Frozen sensors detected and Safe Fallback (setpoint 21.0, damper 1) entered 37.4s after the simulator stopped (threshold 30s + up to one 10s control cycle); MPC resumed 10.0s after restart.
Container restart count 0 -> 1; actuators held their last setpoint during the outage and the MPC resumed dispatching (includes model loading and the 5s start-up delay).
